termi_greeting: Hi! I'm Termi. I help you with learning materials, publishing on Nostr, and finding your way around edufeed.

termi_hint_nip05_body: Your profile has no verified address (NIP-05) yet, so others can't tell it apart from same-named profiles. You can request your own {domain} address in the settings.
termi_hint_profile_body: You don't have a profile yet — others only see a cryptic key instead of your name. Add a name and picture so people recognize you.
termi_sugg_1_a: I help with three things: I answer questions about learning materials, support you in publishing and reading Nostr events, and guide you through edufeed — just tell me where you want to go.
termi_sugg_2_a: There's plenty! Open the Discover section and search for “democracy” — you can also filter by resource type and educational level there.
termi_sugg_3_q: How do I publish on Nostr?
termi_sugg_3_a: Your content is automatically signed as Nostr events and sent to your relays when you publish. Just create something via the plus button — I'll let you know if anything is missing.
termi_fallback: Good question! I can't answer it just yet — my answers are pre-written for now, and real AI support is coming soon. Until then, feel free to try one of the suggestions below.
termi_static_notice: Termi is still learning: answers are pre-written for now — real AI support is coming soon!

concord_invite_direct_empty: No members to pick yet. Search a contact above, paste an npub, or share the invite link.
concord_invite_hint_body: You've been invited to an end-to-end-encrypted area. Take a look and join.
concord_channel_visibility_public_hint: Everyone in the area can read it.
concord_wizard_public_note: Open channels are visible to all members of the area — access depends on your area membership, not a separate channel key.
concord_found_body: Create the first end-to-end encrypted channel for this community.
concord_attach_pane_hint: Already have private areas? Link one — it gets the "Channels" tab here.
concord_attach_lead: Pick one of your private areas. It becomes this community's "Channels" tab — for everyone who is a member of the area.
concord_attach_own_only_hint: Only areas you own can be linked — that way invitations and moderation keep working from inside the community.
concord_attach_public_hint: The link is public on the community profile. Contents, name, and members of the area stay encrypted — only its existence becomes visible.
concord_attach_empty: You don't own any private areas yet. Create one instead — or set one up from another device or client first.
concord_attach_success: "{name}" is now linked to this community
concord_settings_lead: A protected space for your community — with private channels, invitations via link or QR code, and real control over who can read along.
concord_settings_invisible_hint: Invisible to outsiders: neither the area's name nor its members or activity are publicly visible.
concord_settings_linked_ok: Linked — members of the area now see the "Channels" tab in this community. The area no longer has its own entry in the sidebar.
concord_settings_detach_body: "{name}" disappears from this community — the area itself survives. Members keep reaching it via the sidebar, and you can re-link it anytime.
concord_settings_detached_toast: Link removed — the area stays in your sidebar
concord_settings_detach_failed: Removing the link failed. Please try again.
concord_create_with_area_body: Also creates an end-to-end encrypted area with private channels. You can also do this later in the community settings.
concord_create_with_area_key_hint: The area's key lives only on your devices. Back it up after creating — without it there is no way back.
concord_not_ready: Private areas are still starting up — please try again in a moment.
concord_sync_body: Messages arrive encrypted from the relays and are decrypted on this device.
concord_removed_title: You are no longer a member
concord_removed_body: Messages you already received stay readable on this device — new ones no longer reach you.
concord_removed_small: If this was a mistake, an admin can simply invite you again.
concord_no_channels_body: Channels you get access to appear here.
concord_wizard_invisible_hint: Invisible to outsiders — including name, member list and activity.
concord_wizard_invite_lead: Who should be in from the start? Invitees receive the channel key directly and privately.
concord_wizard_link_hint: You can add more people later via invite link or QR code.
concord_wizard_keyloss_body: No server can restore access. If you lose your edufeed key, nobody — not even us — can take over or rescue the channel.
concord_wizard_backup_body: Log in on a second device or store a backup — then you're covered.
concord_wizard_ack: Understood — my key is backed up or I'll back it up right away.
concord_channel_created_partial: Channel "{name}" created — {failed} of {total} invitation(s) could not be sent
concord_locked_body: You haven't received access to this channel yet. Ask an admin for an invitation.
concord_chat_subtitle: End-to-end encrypted · only members can read
concord_dissolved_banner: This area was dissolved. History stays readable for members; new messages are no longer possible.
concord_genesis_body: Messages here are end-to-end encrypted — only members hold the key.
concord_no_key_error: You don't hold this channel's key
concord_invite_link_lead: Anyone who opens this link can join the channel. Only share it with people you trust.
concord_revoke_hint: The current link becomes invalid. Existing members stay.
concord_revoked_notice: Old link revoked — a new link is active. All members remain in the channel.
concord_invite_direct_lead: The invitation is delivered privately and appears in the person's invite inbox.
concord_direct_needs_nip44: Your signer doesn't support NIP-44 — use link invites
concord_link_no_persist_warning: Your signer doesn't support NIP-44, so this link won't be saved to your invite list — revoke it before logging out if needed.
concord_invite_create_failed: Could not create the invite link
concord_join_body: By joining you receive this channel's key. Messages are end-to-end encrypted — only members can read them.
concord_join_revoked_title: This invite link is no longer valid
concord_join_revoked_body: The link was withdrawn by the channel admins. Just ask for a new invitation.
concord_join_login_body: You need to be logged in to accept this invitation.
concord_join_disabled_body: This deployment has private channels switched off.
concord_members_note: All members of this private area. Per-channel activity can lag a few minutes.
concord_role_change_confirm_body: "{name}" will get the {role} role. This changes what they can do in the area.
concord_role_remove_confirm_body: "{name}" loses their assigned role and its permissions in the area.
concord_moderate_needs_nip44: Your signer doesn't support NIP-44 — moderation needs it to deliver the new channel key
concord_kick_confirm_body: {name} loses access to new messages in this channel. With a new invitation they can rejoin anytime.
concord_ban_confirm_body: Banning swaps the channel's lock: all other members automatically receive a new key. {name} can't read anything new — existing invite links no longer work for them either.
concord_ban_confirm_note: Messages {name} already received stay readable on their devices. That cannot technically be undone.
concord_banned_toast: Banned — the channel has a new lock
concord_explainer_row1_body: Messages are encrypted and decrypted on your device. Servers and relays only see unreadable data.
concord_explainer_row2_body: The channel name, members, who writes when — none of it is visible to outsiders.
concord_explainer_row3_body: There is no central member directory. You are a member because you hold the channel's key — it arrives by invitation.
concord_explainer_row4_body: Based on the open Concord protocol: open source, documented and independently auditable.
concord_explainer_beta: Private channels are a beta feature. The edufeed team is happy to answer questions.
concord_backup_body: Your key is your access to all private channels. It lives only on your devices — if it's lost, nobody can restore it.
concord_backup_device_title: Sign in on a second device
concord_backup_export_body: Open settings to save your secret key securely.
concord_keybar_body: Without it there's no way back into this channel — back it up once and you're covered.
concord_dissolve_body: This dissolves ALL private channels of this community. History stays readable for members; new messages become impossible. This cannot be undone.
concord_unlinked_note: This private area isn't linked to a community on this platform.
concord_area_login_body: You need to be logged in to open this private area.
concord_notif_bell_on: Browser notifications on — click to disable
concord_notif_bell_denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings
concord_delete_channel_body: "{name}" and its full history will be removed for all members. This can't be undone.
concord_dissolve_confirm_label: Type the area name to confirm: {name}
groups_empty: No groups yet — paste a group address to join one.
